chunks: 'Abdullāh ibn Abī Ya'fūr narrated from Abū 'Abdillāh عليه السلام, who said:

"Seek forgiveness from Allah in the Witr seventy times, raising your left hand and counting the seeking of forgiveness with your right hand. And the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم used to seek forgiveness from Allah in the Witr seventy times and would say:"
"This is the station of the one seeking refuge in You from the Fire," seven times.

key_terms.الْعَائِذِ: One who seeks refuge and protection
key_terms.الْوَتْرِ: The Witr prayer, the concluding odd-numbered prayer of the night prayer
key_terms.اِسْتَغْفِرِ: Seek forgiveness; an instruction to ask Allah for pardon
key_terms.رَسُولُ اللَّهِ: The Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم
key_terms.سَبْعِينَ: Seventy; the number of times forgiveness is to be sought

ai.seo_question: What should be recited in the qunūt of Witr prayer according to Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches a recommended supplication practice in the Witr prayer: seeking forgiveness seventy times and saying a formula of seeking refuge from the Fire seven times. It also presents this practice as part of the sunnah (prophetic tradition) of the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم, highlighting devotion, repentance, and fear of the Hereafter in night worship.
